e_vec_note: ROUTE A: e_vec = dE/F_vec from measured VALU counters (PMC pt_amd_53070169, 15-pass sandbox re-run, 2026-07-07). F_vec per Eq.(fvec) = 64*(ADD+MUL+TRANS+2*FMA)_F32, MFMA-ratio-scaled to the power window. Inside the 18..130 pJ/FLOP analytic bracket. Fitted on ONE network (MobileNetV2 1-GPU): applying it back is 0% by construction; held-out depthwise validation (mobilenet_v3_large, jobs 53074000/53074001) required before any paper claim. Cross-application to RN-101's measured F_vec (pt_amd_52858992, conv-class-dominated too) overshoots its residual ~1.9x (implied 20.9 pJ/FLOP): do NOT add this term to dense nets, whose vector work is already partly absorbed in the hybrid e_hbm.
